profile_text.body:
UiPath is a publicly traded enterprise software company (NYSE: PATH, CIK 0001734722) that describes itself as providing a platform for business orchestration and automation. Its core offering, the UiPath Platform, is positioned around combining AI agents, robots, and human workers to automate and orchestrate enterprise operations, with the company emphasizing security, compliance, and scale as central design goals.

The company's primary AI product is UiPath AI, which the site tracks under the category of automation and agents. It encompasses robotic process automation, document understanding, process mining, and enterprise automation governance. UiPath highlights use cases across industries including insurance, government, finance, payroll, and advertising. Customer examples cited on the site include Johnson Controls, which the company says saved $18 million and 900,000 hours through automation, Uber, described as on pace to save $22 million, VITAL, which the site says was able to serve 450% more agencies while saving 15,000 work hours, and dentsu, reported to be saving more than 125,000 hours.

No litigation or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for UiPath. The company's profile was verified on 2026-08-16 and it maintains a dedicated page on theworldofai.org.
